prompt: Styrene is treated with Hg(OAc)2, H2O; then NaBH4. Draw the alcohol product.

traps.note: Markovnikov puts OH on the more substituted (here, benzylic) carbon.

explanation: The mercurinium bridge is attacked by water at the carbon that stabilizes positive character — the benzylic position here (Ph-stabilized cation character). No rearrangement.
